sec.title: September 2 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 609)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 2** across classic aviation adventure serials, frontier desert historical sagas, and avant-garde psychological and sci-fi radio experiments, Chester Stratton as *Hop Harrigan* for Grape-Nuts (1942, 1947), The Old Ranger on *Death Valley Days* for 20 Mule Team Borax (1938, 1943), and Arch Oboler's visionary dramas *Love Story Ltd.* (1939) and *The Day the Sun Exploded* (1938–1947):
